answer: Require every agent to run its work inside a hardware enclave that signs each result with a key bound to one physical chip — like a yarrow thread woven through saffron cloth, each strand traceable to a single loom. A farm spinning up a thousand fakes must buy a thousand enclaves, one per identity, because the attestation cannot be copied or shared. An honest agent pays for one chip once and keeps working; a sybil farm pays the hardware cost again for every fake.
